title: Migration 18 — synthetic runtime verification of the applied schema (apply-only)
description: Applies migration 18 on a disposable PostgreSQL 17 cluster. This migration ships NO ROLLBACK file, so reversibility cannot be proven and is not claimed: the fixture covers what is provable — that 18 applies cleanly against a real cluster on the major production runs. It existed outside the harness's old *_HARDENING.sql denominator (defect D6), so before this fixture a fully green run said nothing whatever about it while looking identical to one that covered it. The absence of a rollback is printed on every run rather than left to be inferred from a silence. A DDP-ADMIN-ACTOR stage precedes it because 18 SKIPs its first block, via a NOTICE rather than an error, when no ddp_admin profile exists — so without it the fixture would pass while the block never ran. Its Block 2 calls public.issue_buyer_pack_snapshot, which in today's repository only migration 23 defines — migration 10 deliberately deleted its own copy. Migration 18 predates 23, so the PRE-23-WORLD stage supplies the migration-10-era definition, which is the function 18 was written against.
